name: Missing Metadata Fix
description: Customize episode metadata of anime in your AniList collection.
author: nnotwen, rinkerbel

networkAccess.reasoning: api.themoviedb.org: finds each anime on TMDB and reads its episode stills, titles, overviews, air dates and runtimes. api.ani.zip, animeapi.my.id and animap.id: look up an anime's TMDB and AniDB IDs. proxy.ani.zip: reads AniDB's episode lists (air dates, English titles, summaries) to check an AniDB ID and fill in missing episode data. anime.clap.ing: checks whether Animap, Seanime's own metadata source, has an entry for an anime, the way Seanime asks it.

fields.name: tmdb-api
fields.label: TMDB API Read Access Token (or API key)

fields.name: tmdb-thumbnails
fields.label: Replace episode thumbnails with TMDB stills

fields.name: tmdb-fill-missing
fields.label: Fill in episode metadata from TMDB when Seanime has none

fields.name: anidb-lookup
fields.label: Look up missing AniDB IDs (checked against AniDB's air dates)
